entities.summary: Park Yoo-chun (b. 1986-06-04, Seoul) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Seoul and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
